compare.bar: title: Swipe — cut the stack with split lines, one region per layer; off: the layers lie whole, the first chip on top (S)
title: See-through — a layer's alpha and the space past its picture show the layers below, and a clip past its end disappears; off: every layer covers the ones below it whole (T)
title: Layers as they are, the first chip on top (D toggles)
title: Difference — each layer against all the layers below it: the difference of the whole visible stack (hide a layer to take it out) — equal pixels go black (D)
text: Hit ? for detailed controls description and full hotkeys mapping list
title: Notes — read them, click a picture to go there (C)
title: Draw & write notes on the selected layer (A) — notes go to its file and remember this comparison. Right-click or long-press: reset every tool's settings
title: Flip the selected layer upside down (Shift+V)
title: Guides — grid rulers, or 1-, 2- or 3-point perspective
help.compare: Layout | 1 = Stack | 2 = Tile | 3 = Row | 4 = Column | S = Swipe on / off (Stack): split lines cut the stack, one region per layer | V = Split direction: side by side / top and bottom (Swipe) | D = Over / Difference (Stack): equal pixels go black | T = See-through (Stack): alpha and the space past a picture show the layers below

Layers | ↑ / ↓ = Select the previous / next layer | H = Hide / show the selected layer | Click a chip = Hide / show that layer (while annotating: pick it to annotate) | Ctrl+click a chip = Solo that layer (again: every layer) | Middle-click a chip / × = Remove the layer | Drag a chip = Reorder the layers (touch: hold, then drag) | ⤢ = Open the file in the viewer (the set is kept) | + Add = Bring in another version
